other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India
Applicant must be a permanent resident (domicile) of the state of Maharashtra
Applicant must be enrolled in a school/college recognized by the Government of Maharashtra
Applicant must be a Person with Disability (e.g., visually handicapped, low vision, hearing impaired, orthopedically handicapped, etc.) with disability percentage of 40% or above
Applicant must have passed the 10th standard examination
Applicant must not have failed in the last qualifying examination
Applicant must be pursuing a post‑metric qualification such as Higher Secondary (Class 11th/12th) or a technical/professional degree in fields like medical, engineering, etc.
benefits_summary: Provides monthly scholarship allowances for hostellers and day scholars across various academic groups, along with reader allowances, tuition fee support, study‑tour and project‑typing expenses.
application_link: Step 1: Request a hard copy of the format of the application form for the scheme from the concerned authority at your school/college. Step 2: In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across), and attach all the (self-attested) mandatory documents. Step 3: Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the concerned authority at your school/college. Step 4: Acquire the receipt/acknowledgment of the successful submission of the application form from the concerned authority at your school/college.
